test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 1st November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(11, 13, 17)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

(11, 13, 17) → All the three numbers are prime numbers.

Similarly,

(41, 43, 53) → All the three numbers are prime numbers.

Hence, '**(41, 43, 53)**' is the correct answer.
